topic: Calling the Landlord about a Chirping Smoke Alarm

script.title: THE CHIRPING ALARM
script.story_hook: Three a.m., the alarm chirps, and it won't stop.
script.intro_zh: 凌晨三點，警報器一直叫，怎麼也停不下來。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to a late-night repair call. Listen for alarm troubleshooting phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到一通深夜報修的電話。留意排查警報器的說法。
script.outro: That's a chirping alarm solved. Listen again and try the lines.
script.outro_zh: 一直叫的警報器就這樣搞定。再聽一次，跟著說這些句子。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her late twenties with long straight black hair in a high ponytail, round wire glasses, an oversized cream sweater, flannel pajama pants, and a petite slim build
script.char_b_description: a balding middle-aged man in his fifties with short grey hair on the sides, a thin wire mustache, reading glasses, an olive flannel shirt, dark work pants, and a heavyset build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry to call so late, but it's chirping again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi tə kɔl soʊ leɪt bʌt ɪts ˈtʃɜɹpɪŋ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉這麼晚打來，但它又在叫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem at all, what time is it there?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm ət ɔːl wʌt taɪm ɪz ɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，你那邊幾點了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just past three, it woke me up completely.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst pæst θɹi ɪt woʊk mi ʌp kəmˈplɪtli/
dialogue.zh: 剛過三點，它把我徹底吵醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, that's the low-battery beep, ten to one.
dialogue.phonetic: /æ ðæts ðə loʊ ˈbæɾəɹi bip tɛn tə wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 啊，那是電池快沒電的提示音，幾乎可以確定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten to one? Is that a coin or odds?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn tə wʌn ɪz ðæt ə kɔɪn ɔɹ ɑdz/
dialogue.zh: 幾乎可以確定？是擲硬幣還是機率？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Odds, it means the battery is nearly dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑdz ɪt minz ðə ˈbæɾəɹi ɪz ˈnɪɹli dɛd/
dialogue.zh: 是機率啦，意思是電池快耗盡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I met that same chirp at my old place.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ mɛt ðæt seɪm tʃɜɹp æt maɪ oʊld pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我舊家也遇過那種叫聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They always start at the worst hour, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈɔlweɪz stɑɹt æt ðə wɜɹst aʊə ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 它們總挑最糟的時段開始叫，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I change the battery myself or wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈbæɾəɹi maɪˈsɛlf ɔɹ weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我自己換電池，還是要等？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can, it's a twist-off, very easy honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kən ɪts ə twɪst ɔf ˈvɛɹi ˈizi ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 你可以自己換，是旋轉式的，其實很好換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, which battery does that round one take?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wɪtʃ ˈbæɾəɹi dʌz ðæt raʊnd wʌn teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那個圓圓的小東西用哪種電池？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A nine volt, the square kind, top drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə naɪn voʊlt ðə skwɛɹ kaɪnd tɑp dɹɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 九伏特方形電池，最上面抽屜就有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The square one? I only have round AA's.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skwɛɹ wʌn aɪ ˈoʊnli hæv raʊnd ˌeɪ ˈeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 方形的？我只有圓的五號電池。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, I have spares, I'll bring one over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt aɪ hæv spɛɹz aɪl bɹɪŋ wʌn ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對，我有備用的，我帶一顆過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's kind, but is tonight even an option?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts kaɪnd bʌt ɪz təˈnaɪt ˈiːvən ən ˈɑpʃən/
dialogue.zh: 你真好，不過今晚還來得及嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not tonight, I'm already asleep, to be honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt təˈnaɪt aɪm ɔːlˈɹɛdi əˈslip tə bi ˈɑnɪst/
dialogue.zh: 今晚不行，我早就睡了，老實說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, fair enough, morning works fine for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛɹ ɪˈnʌf ˈmɔɹnɪŋ wɝks faɪn fɔɹ mi/
dialogue.zh: 哈，也對，早上對我就挺好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine sound good? I'll knock, you let me in.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn saʊnd ɡʊd aɪl nɑk ju lɛt mi ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 九點可以嗎？我會敲門，到時你開門讓我進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine is perfect. Can you check the other floors?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ɪz ˈpɝfɪkt kən ju tʃɛk ði ˈʌðɚ flɔɹz/
dialogue.zh: 九點非常好。你能順便看看其他樓層嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, how many alarms does this unit have?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ haʊ ˈmɛni əˈlɑɹmz dʌz ðɪs ˈjunɪt hæv/
dialogue.zh: 當然，這間房子有幾個偵測器？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three, one per hall, plus one in the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi wʌn pɚ hɔːl plʌz wʌn ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/
dialogue.zh: 三個，每條走廊各一個，廚房再加一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll test all three while I'm there.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl tɛst ɔːl θɹi waɪl aɪm ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我到時會三顆都測試一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One might be the kitchen one, it's finicky.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn maɪt bi ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn wʌn ɪts ˈfɪnɪki/
dialogue.zh: 有一顆可能是廚房那顆，它很愛亂叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kitchen alarms go off from steam, it's normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɪtʃɪn əˈlɑɹmz ɡɑ ɑf fɹʌm stim ɪts ˈnɔɹməl/
dialogue.zh: 廚房那顆會因為蒸汽亂叫，其實沒壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know, I blamed it last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ aɪ bleɪmd ɪt læst wik/
dialogue.zh: 那太好了，上週我還怪過它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happens a lot, cooking sets the thing off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpənz ə lɑt ˈkʊkɪŋ sɛts ðə θɪŋ ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 常有的事，做飯就會讓它響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I move it off the stove a bit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ muːv ɪt ɔf ðə stoʊv ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我該把它從爐子上方移開一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can't move it, code says it stays put there.
dialogue.phonetic: /kænt muːv ɪt koʊd sɛz ɪt steɪz pʊt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 不能移動，規定說它要待在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, then what do I do about the smoke?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɛn wʌt du aɪ du əˈbaʊt ðə smoʊk/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那遇到油煙該怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open a window, run the fan, problem solved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ə ˈwɪndoʊ ɹʌn ðə fæn ˈpɹɑbləm sɑːlvd/
dialogue.zh: 開窗、開排氣扇，問題就解決了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart. Do I need a ladder for the halls?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt du aɪ nid ə ˈlædɚ fɔɹ ðə hɔːlz/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。走廊那些我需要梯子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tall ceilings, I'll bring mine too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tɔːl ˈsilɪŋz aɪl bɹɪŋ maɪn tu/
dialogue.zh: 需要，天花板很高，我也會把我的梯子帶去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a hero, I hate balancing on chairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ə ˈhɪɹoʊ aɪ heɪt ˈbælənsɪŋ ɑn tʃɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 你真是救星，我最討厭站在椅子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody should stand on a dining chair, ever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbədi ʃʊd stænd ɑn ə ˈdaɪnɪŋ tʃɛɹ ˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 誰都不該站在餐椅上，絕對不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted. Now, one thing that worries me more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊɾɪd naʊ wʌn θɪŋ ðæt ˈwɝiz mi mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。還有一件事讓我更擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, is something else going on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd ɪz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɛls ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 你說，還有別的情況嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sometimes there's a faint gas smell at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ðɛɹz ə feɪnt ɡæs mɛl æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有時半夜會有一點淡淡的瓦斯味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, I take that seriously, let me check.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm aɪ teɪk ðæt ˈsɪɹiəsli lɛt mi tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這個我很認真看待，讓我查一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's not bad, just a whiff, twice now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts nɑt bæd dʒʌst ə wɪf twaɪs naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不嚴重，只是聞到一下，已經兩次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have a carbon monoxide detector?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə ˈkɑɹbən məˈnɑksaɪd dɪˈtɛktɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你有沒有一氧化碳偵測器？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, the alarms here are from the last tenant.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ði əˈlɑɹmz hɪɹ ɑɹ fɹʌm ðə læst ˈtɛnənt/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，這裡的警報器是上一個房客留的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll add one, those save lives, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil æd wʌn ðoʊz seɪv laɪvz ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 我們會裝一顆，那種真的能救命。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do. Is the smell a leak, you think?
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du ɪz ðə mɛl ə lik ju θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 拜託了。你覺得那氣味是漏氣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe a loose fitting, the stove's old, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ə lus ˈfɪɾɪŋ ðə stoʊvz oʊld ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 也許是接頭鬆了，爐子很舊了，你知道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I call the gas company too, um?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kɔl ðə ɡæs ˈkʌmpəni tu ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 我要不要也打電話給瓦斯公司？嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they check free, better safe than sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðeɪ tʃɛk fɹi ˈbɛɾɚ seɪf ðæn ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 打吧，他們免費檢查，謹慎一點總比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right. What time will the gas people come?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt wʌt taɪm wɪl ðə ɡæs ˈpipəl kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 好。那瓦斯公司的人會幾點來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They'll call ahead, keep your phone on loud, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪl kɔl əˈhɛd kip jɔɹ foʊn ɑn laʊd oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他們會先打電話，把手機開大聲，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. And the alarm fix is tomorrow, nine?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ænd ði əˈlɑɹm fɪks ɪz təˈmɑɹoʊ naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好的。那偵測器的修理就是明天九點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine sharp, I'll text you if I run late.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ʃɑɹp aɪl tɛkst ju ɪf aɪ ɹʌn leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 九點整，如果我會遲到，我會先傳訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Do I owe you for the visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt du aɪ oʊ ju fɔɹ ðə ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。這趟我要付你錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, batteries and checks are on me here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp ˈbæɾəɹiz ænd tʃɛks ɑɹ ɑn mi hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 不用，電池和檢查都算我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, that's more than most landlords do.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæts mɔɹ ðæn moʊst ˈlændˌlɔɹdz du/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這比大多數房東做得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I manage these myself, I want them safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈmænɪdʒ ðiːz maɪˈsɛlf aɪ wɑnt ðɛm seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 這些房子我自己也在管理，我希望它們安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can tell, thank you for coming out.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən tɛl θæŋk ju fɔɹ ˈkʌmɪŋ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 看得出來，謝謝你願意跑這一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, text me if that beeping starts again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs tɛkst mi ɪf ðæt ˈbipɪŋ stɑɹts əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 應該的，要是它又叫了，就傳訊息找我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will, I hope I sleep now though.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl aɪ hoʊp aɪ slip naʊ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我會的，只希望現在能睡著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can pull the battery for tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kən pʊl ðə ˈbæɾəɹi fɔɹ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你今晚可以先把電池拔下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine, got it, finally some good news at three.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ɡɑt ɪt ˈfaɪnəli sʌm ɡʊd nuz æt θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 九點，記下了，三點總算有好消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep tight now, a fresh battery comes at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip taɪt naʊ ə fɹɛʃ ˈbæɾəɹi kʌmz æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 快睡吧，九點就有新電池。

script.youtube_title: 【凌晨三點🔔】「幾乎可以確定」教你搞定亂叫的煙霧警報器🔋🪜｜聽完就能自己報修｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Chirping Smoke Alarm
script.youtube_title_en: "Ten to One" — Calling the Landlord About a Chirping Smoke Alarm
script.youtube_description:
「幾乎可以確定」——凌晨三點，煙霧警報器一直叫，你該怎麼跟房東開口報修？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就是一通深夜的報修電話。

你會聽到：半夜打電話的客氣開場、聽懂低電量的提示音說法；九伏特方形電池、備用電池、約時間的完整句；廚房亂叫、蒸汽誤報的真相；還有聞到瓦斯味時，怎麼請房東加裝一氧化碳偵測器。

整段只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人真實語感：um、well、so、ha、hmm。聽完你就會用：Do I change...、Nine sound good?、Better safe than sorry、On me。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Ten to one" — it's three a.m. and the smoke alarm won't stop chirping. How do you call your landlord and get it fixed? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice built around one late-night repair call.

You will hear: a polite late-night opener, recognizing the low-battery beep; the nine-volt battery, spares, and scheduling lines; the truth about kitchen false alarms and cooking steam; and asking for a carbon monoxide detector when there's a faint gas smell.

Everything stays in A2 words with real hedge words Americans use: um, well, so, ha, hmm. By the end you'll own Do I change..., Nine sound good?, Better safe than sorry, and On me.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
凌晨三點，煙霧警報器一直叫，你睡得著嗎？電池該怎麼換、要哪一種？半夜聞到一點瓦斯味，又該怎麼跟房東開口？

這一集帶大家走進一通深夜報修電話，從聽懂低電量提示音、約時間換電池，一路聽到廚房誤報、瓦斯味與一氧化碳偵測器，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🔋 開場句：Sorry to call so late, but it's chirping again.
🪜 換電池：A nine volt, the square kind, top drawer.
🔥 聞到瓦斯味：Should I call the gas company too, um?
🛠 約時間：Nine sound good? I'll knock, you let me in.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、hmm 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這通電話走一遍，下次半夜真的遇到警報器亂叫，你也能冷靜說清楚。

祝你夜夜好眠。
